enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in on the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed on the back. Pull the blanket up to the chest. Turn the body onto the right side. Pull the pillow down with the left hand. Turn the body onto the left side. Push the blanket down with the right foot. Turn the fan to low speed with the hand. Pull the blanket back over the shoulders. Turn onto the back again. Stretch both arms above the head. Roll onto the right side. Pull the edge of the blanket with the right hand. Keep both eyes closed. Lie still without moving. Turn the head to the left on the pillow. Roll onto the back again and remain lying down.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Open both eyes. Push the blanket off with both hands. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Put both feet into slippers. Stand up. Walk out of Bedroom 1 to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door with the right hand. Press the light switch on. Turn the tap handle to the cold side. Put both hands under the water. Wet the face with both hands. Pick up the soap bar. Rub the soap between both hands. Rub the soap on the face. Rinse the face with both hands under the tap. Turn the tap handle off. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the rail. Pick up the toothbrush from the cup. Turn the tap on. Wet the toothbrush under the water. Turn the tap off. Pick up the toothpaste tube. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Put the toothpaste tube down. Raise the toothbrush to the mouth. Brush the upper teeth. Brush the lower teeth. Spit into the sink. Turn the tap on. Rinse the mouth with water. Spit again. Turn the tap off. Rinse the toothbrush under the tap. Put the toothbrush back into the cup. Press the light switch off. Open the bathroom door. Walk out of the bathroom. Walk into Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door with the right hand. Take a shirt off the hanger. Take trousers off the rail. Lay both on the bed. Take off the pyjama top. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Take off the pyjama bottoms. Put on the trousers. Close the wardrobe door.

enriched_activities.activity: Quietly checking phone and getting ready for breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down on the edge of the bed. Pick up the phone from the nightstand with the right hand. Press the power button with the thumb. Swipe up on the screen to unlock. Tap the news app icon. Scroll down the news list with the thumb. Tap one article. Scroll through the article. Press the home button. Open the messages app. Type a short reply with both thumbs. Press send. Press the power button to lock the phone. Put the phone down on the nightstand. Stand up from the bed. Walk to the bedroom door. Open the door with the right hand. Walk out to the hallway. Walk to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a relaxed breakfast with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Say good morning to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door with the right hand. Take out the eggs, milk and butter. Put them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out the bread and two plates. Put the plates on the table. Close the cupboard door. Put two slices of bread into the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pick up the frying pan from the shelf. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Twist the dial to medium heat. Drop the butter into the pan. Crack two eggs on the rim of the pan. Pour the eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the eggs in the pan. Turn the eggs over with the spatula. Press the stop button on the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto a plate with the spatula. Take the toast out of the toaster. Put the toast on the plate. Pour milk into two glasses. Carry the plates and glasses to the table. Sit down on the chair opposite Member 2. Pick up the fork. Cut the egg with the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the glass. Drink the milk. Put the glass down. Talk to Member 2 about the day's plan. Pick up the last piece of toast. Eat it. Push the plate forward. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the living room with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the cushions from the floor. Put the cushions on the sofa. Pick up the newspapers from the coffee table. Stack them on the shelf. Carry the two cups to the kitchen counter. Walk back to the living room. Open the storage cabinet door. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Close the cabinet door. Pull the cord out of the vacuum cleaner. Plug the cord into the wall socket. Press the power switch with the right foot. Push the vacuum cleaner forward across the floor. Pull it back. Push it along the edge of the sofa. Lift the sofa leg with the left hand and vacuum under it. Push the vacuum cleaner towards the TV stand. Pull it back again. Push it into the corner near the window. Press the power switch off with the foot. Pull the plug out of the socket. Wrap the cord around the hook. Open the cabinet door. Put the vacuum cleaner back inside. Close the cabinet door. Pick up the cloth from the shelf. Wipe the coffee table with the cloth. Wipe the TV stand with the cloth. Put the cloth back on the shelf. Say to Member 2 that the cleaning is done.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with coffee and catching up on news on the TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Pick up a mug from the shelf. Put the mug under the kettle spout. Press the kettle switch down. Wait for the water to boil. Pour hot water into the mug. Pick up the coffee jar. Spoon coffee powder into the mug. Stir with a spoon. Pick up the mug with the right hand. Walk back to the living room with the mug. Sit down on the sofa. Put the mug on the coffee table. Pick up the TV remote with the right hand. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Press the channel up button. Press the volume up button. Put the remote down on the sofa arm. Pick up the mug. Take a sip of coffee. Put the mug down. Lean back on the sofa. Pick up the remote again. Press the channel down button. Watch the news segment. Pick up the mug again. Take another sip. Put the mug down. Press the power button on the remote to turn the TV off. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at the local market
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the hallway. Pick up the reusable shopping bags from the hook. Open the shoe cabinet. Take out the shoes. Put both shoes on. Tie the laces. Pick up the house keys from the hook. Open the front door with the right hand. Step outside. Close the door behind. Walk down the path to the street. Walk towards the market. Stop at the vegetable stall. Pick up a head of lettuce. Turn it over in both hands. Put it into the shopping bag. Pick up three tomatoes. Put them into the bag. Walk to the fruit stall. Pick up four apples. Put them into the bag. Walk to the dairy stall. Pick up a carton of milk. Put it into the bag. Walk to the checkout counter. Put the bag on the counter. Take out the items one by one. Place them on the scale. Wait while the vendor weighs them. Take the card out of the pocket. Tap the card on the card reader. Put the card back into the pocket. Pick up the filled bags with both hands. Turn around. Walk back towards the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries and preparing lunch ingredients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Put the shopping bags on the counter. Open the refrigerator door with the left hand. Take the milk carton out of the bag. Place it on the shelf. Take the apples out of the bag. Place them in the vegetable drawer. Take the lettuce out. Place it on the shelf. Take the tomatoes out. Place them on the shelf. Close the refrigerator door. Fold the empty shopping bags. Put them into the drawer. Open the cupboard door. Take out the cutting board. Put it on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out the kitchen knife. Put the knife on the cutting board. Close the drawer. Open the refrigerator door. Take the lettuce and tomatoes out. Close the door. Put the lettuce on the cutting board. Turn on the tap. Rinse the lettuce under the water. Turn off the tap. Put the lettuce on the board. Hold the lettuce with the left hand. Cut the lettuce with the knife into strips. Push the strips to the side of the board. Put the tomatoes on the board. Cut the tomatoes into slices with the knife. Push the slices next to the lettuce. Rinse the knife under the tap. Put the knife back into the drawer. Pick up the bowl from the shelf. Put the cut lettuce and tomatoes into the bowl. Put the bowl on the counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Stand at the counter next to Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the eggs and cheese. Close the refrigerator door. Put the eggs and cheese on the counter. Pick up the frying pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Twist the dial to medium heat. Pour oil into the pan. Crack two eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the eggs. Add the cut vegetables to the pan. Stir again with the spatula. Sprinkle salt into the pan. Press the stop button on the induction cooker. Slide the food onto two plates with the spatula. Carry the plates to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork with the right hand. Cut the food. Lift it to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Take a slice of bread from the basket. Bite the bread. Talk to Member 2 during the meal. Put the fork down. Pick up the glass of water. Drink. Put the glass down. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Put the plates into the dishwasher. Pick up the pan. Rinse the pan under the tap. Put the pan into the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a film on the TV and relaxing
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the kitchen to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote with the right hand. Point the remote at the TV. Press the power button. Press the input button. Select the streaming app with the arrow buttons. Press the OK button. Scroll down the film list. Press the OK button on a film. Press the play button. Put the remote down on the coffee table. Lean back against the sofa cushions. Cross the legs on the footstool. Watch the screen. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume down button. Put the remote down. Pick up the cushion and place it behind the back. Watch the film. Pick up the remote again. Press the pause button. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Walk back to the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Press the play button. Continue watching the film. Press the power button to turn the TV off at the end. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to browse and work on a personal hobby project
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Pull the chair out from under the desk. Sit down on the chair. Press the power button on the desk lamp. Open the laptop lid with both hands. Press the power button on the computer. Wait for the screen to load. Type the login password on the keyboard. Move the mouse with the right hand. Click the browser icon. Type a search term on the keyboard. Press the Enter key. Scroll down the page with the mouse wheel. Click one link. Read the page. Click the back button. Open the project folder on the desktop. Double-click the project file. Type text on the keyboard. Press Ctrl and S to save the file. Move the mouse to select a tool. Click and drag on the canvas. Press Ctrl and S again. Open a new browser tab. Type a search term. Press Enter. Scroll the results. Click a reference page. Switch back to the project window. Type more text. Press Ctrl and S. Push the chair back. Stand up. Close the laptop lid. Press the desk lamp switch off. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

enriched_activities.activity: Going for a long walk in the park and enjoying the holiday weather
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the hallway. Open the shoe cabinet. Take out the walking shoes. Sit on the bench. Put both shoes on. Tie the laces. Stand up. Pick up the house keys from the hook. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk down the path towards the street. Turn left at the corner. Walk along the pavement. Cross the road at the crossing. Enter the park through the gate. Walk along the main path. Pass the pond. Turn right at the fork. Walk up the small slope. Walk past the playground. Keep walking along the loop path. Stop at the drinking fountain. Press the button. Drink water from the fountain. Walk on. Turn left onto the side path. Walk under the trees. Walk back towards the park gate. Exit the park. Cross the road. Walk back along the pavement. Walk up the path to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door. Take off both shoes. Put them into the shoe cabinet.

enriched_activities.activity: Listening to music and reading while relaxing with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa next to Member 2. Pick up the phone from the pocket with the right hand. Press the power button. Swipe up to unlock. Open the music app. Tap a playlist. Tap the play button. Put the phone down on the coffee table. Pick up the book from the coffee table with both hands. Open the book to the bookmark. Lean back on the sofa. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the page. Turn the page again. Pick up the phone. Press the volume up button. Put the phone down. Pick up the book again. Turn the page. Read the next page. Say a sentence to Member 2 about the music. Turn the page. Put the bookmark between the pages. Close the book. Put the book down on the coffee table. Pick up the phone. Tap the pause button. Put the phone down on the coffee table.

Walk into the kitchen with Member 2. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Put the ingredients on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out the cutting board. Put the board on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out the knife. Put the knife on the board. Close the drawer. Turn on the tap. Rinse the vegetables under the water. Turn off the tap. Put the vegetables on the board. Hold a vegetable with the left hand. Cut it into pieces with the knife. Push the pieces into the bowl. Cut the chicken on the board with the knife. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button. Twist the dial to high heat. Pour oil into the pan. Pick up the bowl. Tip the vegetables into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Add the chicken to the pan. Stir again. Sprinkle salt and pepper into the pan. Twist the dial to low heat. Put the lid on the pan. Wait while the food cooks. Twist the dial to the off position. Press the power button off. Rinse the knife under the tap. Put the knife back into the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the dishes with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up two plates from the shelf. Put the plates on the counter. Spoon the food from the pan onto the plates. Carry the plates to the table. Pick up two forks from the drawer. Put the forks next to the plates. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork with the right hand. Cut the food. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew and swallow. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Put the glass down. Talk to Member 2 during the meal. Pick up the fork again. Eat the rest of the food. Put the fork down on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plates to the sink. Scrape the leftovers into the bin. Open the dishwasher door. Put the plates into the dishwasher rack. Put the forks into the basket. Pick up the pan. Rinse the pan under the tap. Put the pan into the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button on the dishwasher. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Hang the cloth on the hook.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and playing a game on the console with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room with Member 2. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote with the right hand. Press the power button on the TV. Press the input button. Select the console input with the arrow buttons. Press the OK button. Pick up the game controller from the shelf. Press the power button on the controller. Hand the second controller to Member 2. Press the start button. Select a game from the menu with the arrow buttons. Press the A button to confirm. Hold the controller with both hands. Press the buttons with the thumbs. Move the controller to the left. Press the shoulder button. Talk to Member 2 about the game. Press the pause button. Put the controller down on the sofa. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Put the glass down. Pick up the controller again. Press the start button. Continue playing. Press the buttons repeatedly. Finish the round. Put the controller down. Pick up the remote. Press the power button on the TV. Press the power button on the controller to switch it off. Put the controller back on the shelf.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and washing up before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Press the light switch on. Press the water heater switch on. Take off the shirt. Take off the trousers. Hang the clothes on the hook. Step into the shower area. Turn the shower tap to the warm side. Put the right hand under the water to check the temperature. Turn the tap handle to adjust. Step under the water. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the left hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap bar. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body under the water. Turn the tap handle off. Step out of the shower area. Pick up the towel from the rail. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the rail. Take the pyjamas off the hook. Put on the pyjama top. Put on the pyjama bottoms. Press the light switch off. Open the bathroom door. Walk out to the hallway.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking the phone under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Sit down on the edge of the bed. Press the desk lamp switch on. Pick up the book from the nightstand with both hands. Open the book to the bookmark. Turn the page with the right hand. Read the page. Turn the page again. Read the next page. Put the book down on the nightstand. Pick up the phone with the right hand. Press the power button. Swipe up to unlock. Tap the messages app. Scroll through the message list with the thumb. Type a reply with both thumbs. Press send. Press the home button. Open the news app. Scroll down the news list. Tap one article. Scroll through the article. Press the home button. Press the power button to lock the phone. Put the phone down on the nightstand. Pick up the book again. Read one more page. Put the bookmark between the pages. Close the book. Put the book down on the nightstand. Press the desk lamp switch off.

Pull the blanket down with the right hand. Lie down on the bed on the right side. Pull the blanket up over the body with both hands. Adjust the pillow under the head with the left hand. Turn the body onto the back. Push the blanket down with the right foot. Turn the fan to low speed with the right hand. Turn the body onto the left side. Pull the edge of the blanket with the left hand. Close both eyes. Remain lying still. Turn the head on the pillow. Turn the body onto the right side. Keep both arms under the blanket. Remain lying without moving. Continue sleeping.
